SELECTED_INDEX: 1  
CONFIDENCE: 0.28  
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows (i) a very strong band at 1069 cm⁻¹ that fits the characteristic S=O stretching region of sulfoxides (≈1030–1070 cm⁻¹); (ii) two intense bands at 623 and 654 cm⁻¹, a region where C–S and S–O deformation modes of thioethers / sulfoxides are normally found; (iii) only aliphatic C-H stretches (2895–2966 cm⁻¹) and no aromatic C=C stretches, consistent with a small saturated ring bearing alkyl substituents.  
Among the candidates, only molecule 1 (CC1CC(C)[S+]([O-])CS1) contains an S=O (sulfoxide) group together with C–S bonds in a saturated ring, accounting simultaneously for the 1069 cm⁻¹ S=O stretch and the strong 600–660 cm⁻¹ C–S/S–O modes, while also providing the required aliphatic C–H bands. The other candidates lack an S=O group and cannot explain the strong 1069 cm⁻¹ band.
